name: agent-character-kit
description: Character-enforcement companion for ChatGPT and Codex. Thin client to the ACK daemon: habit skills plus fail-closed tool hooks. Deterrent, not a security boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Fail-closed character enforcement for agent tool calls
interface.longDescription: Packages ACK habits as skills and Codex lifecycle hooks. Policy stays in the ACK daemon. Optional MCP is mcp.json → http://127.0.0.1:8754/mcp (ACK_MCP_HTTP). No Apps SDK widgets. This plugin does not evaluate constitution or allow/deny lists locally. Deterrent, not a cage.
defaultPrompt: Use ACK when a tool is about to run or a hold is returned.
Acknowledge the hold in ACK habit format, then continue.
Use configure-character to add or retune a habit.
